trades.reasoning: Highest-scoring candidate (95) with full four-signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — matching our strongest setup criteria despite the flat broader tape.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.4%), not a clear risk-on or risk-off signal. With 3 open slots and cash above our $500 threshold, we added one high-conviction position (ALAB) that cleared all four confirmation signals, while holding the rest of our winners through the quiet session.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no dominant catalyst, reflecting a consolidation phase after recent gains rather than a shift in sentiment. Trading volumes were unremarkable across most of the market, suggesting investors are waiting for clearer signals before making large moves. Semiconductor and networking names continued to show relative strength despite the broader softness.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤指數小幅回落，並無明顯的利多或利淡消息主導市場，反映近期升勢後的整理格局，而非市場情緒轉向。大部分板塊成交量平平，顯示投資者在等待更明確的方向才會加大動作。儘管大市偏軟，半導體及網絡相關股份仍保持相對強勢。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of relying on just one indicator, strong traders look for multiple signals to line up together — like a bullish RSI, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — before committing capital. When all four agree, it suggests real buying interest rather than random noise, which is why ALAB stood out even on an otherwise quiet market day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 優秀的交易者不會只依賴單一指標，而是尋找多個訊號同時出現——例如RSI處於偏強區間、MACD黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，以及成交量放大——才決定投入資金。當這四個訊號同時符合，代表市場有實質買盤支持，而非隨機波動，這正是ALAB即使在大市平淡時仍然突出的原因。
